description:
The Urban Wage Employment Scheme (UWPS) is an initiative by the Government of India. 

It aims to provide wage employment to urban poor. 

The scheme is designed to enhance livelihood opportunities in urban areas. 

The objective is to reduce poverty and improve living standards. 

The benefits include guaranteed wage employment for a specified number of days. 

Assistance is provided in the form of daily wages for work performed. 

Eligibility is primarily focused on urban poor individuals and families. 

The application process typically involves registration with local authorities. 

Details on the exact timeline or frequency of employment opportunities may vary. 

Implementing authorities include state governments and urban local bodies. 

The scheme is part of broader efforts to address urban unemployment. 

It aligns with the goals of sustainable urban development.
